nodes.label: Modular Monolith With Separate Worker
nodes.rationale: One release, one database, explicit module ownership; long-running inference and LLM work must not block form saving or browsing.

nodes.label: Sequential Clinical-Question Reasoning Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Fixed network definitions plus LLM CPT estimation plus application-owned inference keeps estimation, execution and rendering separately accountable.

nodes.label: Offline DDI Ingestion Contract
nodes.rationale: Converting monographs once into a validated immutable dataset keeps the runtime checker a deterministic lookup instead of an LLM judgment.

nodes.label: Pure Assessment Evaluation Contract
nodes.rationale: evaluate(definition, answers) with no I/O keeps unanswered, partial, complete, not-assessed and bypassed states distinct instead of defaulting missing answers to zero.
